other_conditions: The surviving spouse of the deceased pensioner is eligible
The deceased worker must have been receiving a pension from the Meghalaya Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
The spouse must not be receiving any pension from any Government, Semi‑Government or Private organization
The spouse must not be receiving any salary from any Government, Semi‑Government or Private organization
benefits_summary: A family pension of 50% of the deceased’s pension or ₹100, whichever is higher, is paid to the surviving spouse.
